params.name: Read probe marker
params.overview: Read probe.txt, confirm the marker it contains, and report that marker to the user—no file changes, skills, or network.
params.plan:
# Read and report probe.txt marker

## Steps

1. Read [`probe.txt`](probe.txt) in the workspace (read-only).
2. Confirm the marker string present in the file.
3. Report the confirmed marker to the user.

## Constraints

- Do not modify any files.
- Do not use outside skills or the network.

todos.content: Confirm the marker value in the file
Report the confirmed marker to the user
